title: Skin Care for Raipur Weather: A Routine for Scorching Summers, a Long Monsoon and Dry Winters
ex: Very hot dry summers, a long humid monsoon and cool, dry winters: a simple, season-by-season skin care routine for people living in Raipur.
rt: Skin Care for Raipur Weather by Season | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for Raipur weather: sun care for scorching dry summers, light layers in the long monsoon and a richer night routine for cool, dry winters.
quick: Raipur is very hot and dry from March to mid-June, humid in the monsoon to September and cool and dry from December to February. Use a gentle face wash and broad-spectrum sunscreen all year, light gel layers in the hot and wet months, and a fuller night cream and lip balm in winter.
facts: Raipur is on the plains of central Chhattisgarh, far from the sea
March to mid-June is very hot and mostly dry, with hot winds and dust
The monsoon runs roughly mid-June to September
December to February brings cool, dry mornings and bright sun
